title: Sales Director, Payments (DACH)
description:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more. 

Welcome to Fireblocks, the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

Here’s the bit about us:

Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O.

As of January 2026, we serve over 2400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale

title: Working Student - Labelling (f/m/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies.
 At TYTAN , we set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-drive, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.
 We are now looking for a team member who wants to make an impact. As a Working Student in Data Labeling (m/f/d) , you will support the team by preparing and managing perception data, ensuring dataset quality, help organize and collect flight recordings used to train our AI models .
 Responsibilities
 Annotate and curate perception datasets using our internal annotation tools and help improve it
 Maintain and improve the quality of existing labeled datasets
 Organize and manage large-scale perception datasets and recording structures (UAV with cameras)
 Coordinate with the flight testing team to plan and collect new training data
 Assist with organizing recorded flight data and metadata
 Your Profile
 Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
 Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality, consistent annotations
 Comfortable working with Linux-based systems
 Basic experience with Python scripting
 Interest in computer vision, machine learning, or robotics
 Ability to work independently and take ownership of processes
 Good communication skills and ability to coordinate across teams
 Nice to Have
 Experience with computer vision datasets (e.g. COCO, KITTI, YOLO formats)
 Experience using annotation tools (CVAT, Label Studio, Labelme, etc.)
 Basic understanding of object detection, tracking, or segmentation models
 Experience with Git / DVC

title: Working Student - HR Operations (f/m/d)
description:
At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.
 As our Working Student in HR Operations, you'll be right in the middle of the action keeping our HR function running smoothly, helping our HR team stay one step ahead as we scale, from coordinating on-boarding to preparing welcome merchandise to keeping our HRIS up to date.
 This role goes beyond routine admin. We are looking for someone flexible and reliable who is comfortable filling in the gaps, spotting what needs attention, and supporting the team wherever the workload calls for it.
 Your Roadmap to Impact:
 Onboarding Coordination: You help coordinate the on boarding processes for our new hires, scheduling, documentation, system access, preparing the welcome merchandise and making sure everything is ready before their first day.
 HRIS Maintenance: You assist in keeping our HRIS accurate and up to date, whether through your regular monthly update or as changes come in throughout the month.
 Employee Inquiries: You act as a first point of contact for everyday employee questions, answering what you can and routing anything more complex to the right person on the team.
 General HR Support: You fill in the little gaps across HR operations, whatever the team needs that week, helping keep things running without anything falling through the cracks.
 You are currently enrolled as a student (Bachelor's or Master's), ideally in HR, business administration, psychology, or a related field.
 You are flexible and comfortable switching between different types of tasks day to day.
 You have an ownership mentality and ready to take on tasks as they come.
 You have a strong eye for detail, especially when it comes to data accuracy and confidentiality.
 You are organized and reliable, and enjoy jumping in wherever help is needed.
